title: Methylidene Rare-Earth-Metal Complex Mediated Transformations of C=N, N=N and N-H Bonds: New Routes to Imido Rare-Earth-Metal Clusters

synthesis.procedure: A solution of complex 2b (0.200 g, 0.1 mmol) in toluene (10 mL) was placed in a tube with a Teflon stopcock and degassed by a freeze–pump–thaw cycle. 2 atm of CO2 were introduced; a color change from yellow to colorless was observed within 10 min. The mixture was stirred for 0.5 h at room temperature, concentrated to saturation under vacuum, and pale-yellow crystals of 9b (0.191 g, 86%) formed after standing at room temperature for 2 days. All manipulations were performed with exclusion of air and water using Schlenk techniques or a glovebox.
synthesis.time: color change within 10 min; stirred 0.5 h; crystallized 2 days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: concentrated to saturation under vacuum; pale-yellow crystals obtained after standing at room temperature for 2 days
